config_name.description: This is the VESC Express Logging and Communication Module.

hw_name.description: Orthopus Custom config

joint_name.description: Orthopus Joint name

simu_mode.description:
When using custom CAN communication, this enables a simulation mode:

Commands received are echoed back with a low pass filter.
This allows for testing high level control and CAN communication without making the motor move.

stream_rate_10.description: CAN streaming frequency of measures

encoder_offset.description: Output encoder offset, used for actuator position offset

encoder_max_diff.description: Max error allowed between output encoder and motor encoder (taking into account reduction ratio)

limits_enable.description: Enable software limits

limits_enable_reaction.description:
Simulates a physical end stop with a given siffnes/damping, set by limits_* parameters.

Adds a torque reaction at limits, active only in torque/impedance control modes, when this variable is True

limits_pos_min.description:
Software min angme limit in degrees.

Crossing this limit disables the actuator. Limits reactions should brake the actuator before crossing this limit in impedance control mode.

limits_pos_max.description:
Software max angme limit in degrees.
Crossing this limit disables the actuator. Limits reactions should brake the actuator before crossing this limit in impedance control mode.

limits_kp.description: limits stiffness

limits_kd.description: limits damping

limits_powp.description: limits stiffness evolution pow

limits_powd.description: limits damping evolution pow

limits_damp_reachangle.description: Area before the linit in which only damping is applied, only when moving in the idrection of limit

limits_reach_angle.description: Margin before the limit in which tle control reaction (variable stiffnss /damping) is active.

limits_reach_speed.description:
Maximal speed at which the actuator can run in direction of the limit, inside the reach angle.
Crossing this speed limit in this angle area disables actuator.

perf_rate_hz.description: Rate of main control loop in Hz

perf_compensateexectime.description:
Measures the execution time of the control loop and compensates this time for better real time.
Deprecated: will be removed, works fine without compensation.

ctrl_deadzone.description: Enable a deazone near torque zero for impedance control - flattens the control output near zero

ctrl_sample_adc3.description:
Sample toque sensor analog output in high frequency pwm loop
Should be better enabled, sinces it allows for higher filtering without mode lag.

ctrl_torquezero.description:
torque sensor ADC offset.
use o_control zerotorque to set.

ctrl_torquegain.description: gain of the torque sensor N.M / Volts

ctrl_stiffness.description: Stiffness of the impedance control

ctrl_damping.description: Damping of the impedance control

ctrl_kp.description: Torque control Kp of impedance control

ctrl_a.description:
Deadzone flattens the control output near zero with the factr a:
ctrl = ctrl - atanf(ctrl*a)/a

ctrl_kd.description: Torque control Kd of impedance control

ctrl_kd_filter.description:
Filter constant of the low pass filter on torque derivative used for torque control Kd:
1: not filtered

torque_filter_const.description:
Filter constant of the low pass filter on torque measure.
1: not filtered

CAUTION: the actual low pass filter time constant will depend on the frequency of the torque acquisition (see ctrl_sample_adc3). you can filter much more with same time constant when sampling at high frequency.

safety_max_q_error.description: Max difference allowed between desired position qd and measured position qmes in degrees

safety_max_speed.description: Maximum actuator speed that triggers safety brake (rpm)

auto_clear_errors.description:
If True, auto clears control errors when the condition is back to normal
If False, sending a control word of 0x000 is required to reset errors

safety_track_disable.description:
Disable tracking errors in pos, vel and torque mode.
WARNING: use only for development in safe conditions

safety_timeout_disable.description:
Disable CAN timeout safety
WARNING: use only for development in safe conditions

safety_max_speed_disable.description:
Disable safety max speed
WARNING: use only for development in safe conditions

input_shaper_enable.description: Enables input shaping in impedance control mode

input_shaper_A1.description: Input shaper A1 is the amount of the command that will be sent immediately. A1 should be near 0.5 or above for damped modes.

input_shaper_T1.description: Input shaper delay (in ms). once one part of the command (A1) is sent immediately, the other part (1-A1) is added T1 ms after

encoder_filter_const.description: Output encoder filter constant (1.0: no filtering 0:max filtering)

ff_torque_constant.description: Feedforward used in torque control (N.m/A)

speed_filter_const.description: Speed low pass filter constant (sampled at high frequency)
